import pytest

from typesystem.tokenize.tokens import Token


class _ChildToken(Token):
    """Concrete Token that returns a fixed child for any key."""

    def __init__(self, child):
        super().__init__(value="child-holder", start_index=0, end_index=0)
        self._child = child

    def _get_child_token(self, key):
        return self._child


def test_lookup_traverses_children():
    leaf = Token(value="leaf", start_index=0, end_index=4)
    middle = _ChildToken(child=leaf)
    root = _ChildToken(child=middle)

    result = root.lookup(index=[0, 1])

    assert result is leaf
    assert result._value == "leaf"


def test_lookup_empty_index_returns_self():
    token = Token(value="root", start_index=0, end_index=4)

    result = token.lookup(index=[])

    assert result is token

from typesystem.base import Position
from typesystem.tokenize.tokens import Token


def test_get_position_empty_content():
    token = Token(None, 0, 0, content="")
    pos = token._get_position(0)
    assert isinstance(pos, Position)
    assert pos == Position(1, 1, 0)
    assert (pos.line_no, pos.column_no, pos.char_index) == (1, 1, 0)


def test_get_position_single_line():
    token = Token(None, 0, 2, content="hello")
    pos = token._get_position(1)
    assert pos == Position(1, 2, 1)
    assert (pos.line_no, pos.column_no, pos.char_index) == (1, 2, 1)


def test_get_position_multi_line():
    token = Token(None, 0, 5, content="ab\ncd")
    pos = token._get_position(4)
    assert pos == Position(2, 2, 4)
